excerpt.zh:
星海帝国受到了致命的打击就此一蹶不振。由于其崩溃在即，我们现在可以恢复原有的星海共同体。

让这个互相沟通理解的平台取代掉独裁暴政吧！
excerpt.en:
The Galactic Imperium has been dealt a mortal blow from which it cannot recover. With its imminent collapse, we are now in a position to restore the old Galactic Community.

Let it serve as platform of diplomacy and mutual understanding instead of tyranny!

texts.zh:
星海帝国受到了致命的打击就此一蹶不振。由于其崩溃在即，我们现在可以恢复原有的星海共同体。

让这个互相沟通理解的平台取代掉独裁暴政吧！
texts.en:
The Galactic Imperium has been dealt a mortal blow from which it cannot recover. With its imminent collapse, we are now in a position to restore the old Galactic Community.

Let it serve as platform of diplomacy and mutual understanding instead of tyranny!

texts.zh:
战争的结束近在咫尺。帝国军的残部要么成建制地投降，要么在夜幕中溃逃散尽，这正是帝国正在凋亡的迹象。

现在，[dissolve_winner.GetName]就已经开始了重建原有的星海共同体的工作。整个星系中，帝国的旗帜被撕毁或焚烧。而一个新的未来正展现在我们的眼前。
texts.en:
The end is here. As the remaining Imperial forces surrender en masse or melt away into the night, it has become evident that the Imperium is dying.

Even now, the [dissolve_winner.GetName] has begun the work of rebuilding the old Galactic Community. Imperial banners are being torn down or put to the flame across the galaxy. A new future is upon us.

label.en: We must find our place in it.

texts.zh:
星海帝国陷落了。帝国军要么就地溃散要么成建制地投降，帝国的疆域被解放了。

饱受战争之苦的前帝国的疆域中秩序正在逐渐恢复，[dissolve_winner.GetName]认为是时候重建原有星海共同体了。我们收到了一份成员邀请，是否加入呢？
texts.en:
The Galactic Imperium has fallen. With Imperial forces melting away or surrendering en masse, the Imperium's sovereign has abdicated.

As order is slowly restored to the war-torn systems of the former Imperium, the [dissolve_winner.GetName] has seen fit to resurrect the old Galactic Community. We have received a membership invitation. Should we join?

label.zh: 当然！是时候重新回到星系舞台了。
label.en: Of course! It is time to rejoin the galaxy.

label.zh: 不了。它不过是下一个帝国的温床罢了。
label.en: No. It could turn into another Imperium.
